**Stacked on #1764.** It lands after #1764, with base `claude/quirky-davinci-ixuymr`. Bean `2h76`. It fixes the two gaps that arc 3fva identified on #1850 ([comment](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant/issues/1850#issuecomment-5962532789)).

Owner rulings (2026-10-02, verbatim):
- *"go with cat/cat-harness/todos and cat/cat-harness/beans as their own named sub-graph branches"*
- *"(not all named subgraphs get own branch, especially not semi-static KG content)"*
- *"keep workong. fix gaps"*

## Changes
- **`DirectoryStorageSchema.keyedBy`** is now `z.enum(["commit", "tip"])`. A refinement on `ContentDirectorySchema` **refuses `"tip"` on a `qa` directory**, so QA stays commit-keyed by schema. `directory-storage.test.ts` covers both values and the refusal.
- **New `cat-harness/scripts/branch-store.ts`**, generic over a declared directory whose `storage.keyedBy` is `"tip"`:
  - reads, lists and splice-writes a state branch at its tip, keeping unrelated files;
  - has hit / miss / corrupt / unknown read states;
  - pushes in a loop that **never uses `-f`** and retries when the tip moves;
  - takes an optional per-path `expect`, which turns a same-file race into a conflict.
  
  Its parts are modelled on `qa-store.ts`. Tests: `branch-store.test.ts`, against a local temporary bare repo with no network.
- **`qa-store.ts`: one type-only line** (`QaDirectory.storage` is now `DirectoryStorage`), which is needed for tsc once `keyedBy` widens. There is no behaviour change, and the coordinator approved it. Adopting `branch-store.ts` inside qa-store is 3fva's call later, as a new bean.
- Docs: the proposal (`state-branch-2026-10-02.md` §3.2/§3.4) and the skill (§`storage.keyedBy`), plus the regenerated artefacts.

## Not in this PR (switch stays off)
- No reader or writer of `beans/` or `todos/` changes, and no `storage` declaration is added to `cat-harness.json`. **`main` stays authoritative.** The flip is step 4 of the changeover the merge steward runs on #1850.
- The intended declarations, for the flip:
  - `beans/` → `storage: { branch: "cat/cat-harness/beans", keyedBy: "tip" }`
  - `todos/` → `storage: { branch: "cat/cat-harness/todos", keyedBy: "tip" }`

## Overlap
#1801 (also stacked on #1764) changes `directory-storage.test.ts` at ~line 127, the expected default branch → `cat/cat-harness/qa-reports`. **Whichever lands second keeps both edits.**

## Status
The agent was cut off by a container restart after pushing these two commits locally. They have now been pushed. **Full `bun run gates` has not been re-run since the restart**, so CI on this head is the check.
